reading.title: The Impact of Renewable Energy on Global Economy
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power have become increasingly important in recent years. Many countries are investing heavily in these technologies to reduce carbon emissions and combat climate change. Solar energy, in particular, has experienced significant cost reductions, making it more accessible to developing nations. This shift toward renewable energy is creating new job opportunities in manufacturing, installation, and maintenance sectors. Additionally, renewable energy reduces dependence on fossil fuels, which strengthens energy security and promotes sustainable economic growth.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of renewable energy adoption?
options: Creates job opportunities in multiple sectors
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '신재생에너지는 제조, 설치, 유지보수 분야에서 새로운 일자리를 창출한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Why has solar energy become more accessible to developing nations?
questions.explanation: 태양에너지의 비용이 크게 감소했기 때문에 개발도상국이 더 쉽게 접근할 수 있게 되었습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a consequence of reducing fossil fuel dependence?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 재생에너지가 화석연료 의존도를 줄임으로써 에너지 안보를 강화한다고 설명합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made modern life better'? Use specific examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시 (동의 또는 반대)와 함께 2-3가지 주요 이유를 간단히 언급합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유를 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다. (예: 의료 기술, 통신, 교육 등)
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유를 다른 관점에서 제시합니다. (예: 효율성, 접근성, 시간 절약 등)
structure.conclusion: 주요 포인트를 요약하고 최종 입장을 재확인합니다.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology has significantly improved modern life.
Furthermore, technology has made communication more efficient.
For example, medical advancements have extended human lifespan.
In conclusion, the benefits of technology outweigh its drawbacks.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in large companies. Others prefer to work in small startups. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: I prefer working in [large companies/startups] because...
In my view, this is important because...
sample_points: 큰 회사: 안정적인 급여, 명확한 경력 발전 경로, 포괄적인 복리후생 제공
스타트업: 창의성 발휘, 빠른 의사결정, 다양한 업무 경험, 성장 기회

listening.title: University Library Orientation
listening.script: Professor: Welcome to the library orientation session. Today I'll explain how our digital resources work. Most of our academic journals and databases are available online through our website. You'll need your student ID to log in. We have thousands of peer-reviewed articles covering science, history, literature, and more. Student: Can I access these resources from home? Professor: Yes, absolutely. You can access everything remotely using the library portal. We also offer research workshops every Thursday at 2 PM where librarians can help you find specific sources for your assignments. Additionally, we have physical books organized by the Dewey Decimal System. If you need help locating materials, our librarians at the front desk are always available. Student: That's helpful. Are there any printing services? Professor: Yes, you can print from the computers in our study areas. The first 100 pages per semester are free. After that, it's a small fee. We want to encourage digital reading to save paper.

questions.q: What is required to access the library's digital resources?
When are the research workshops held?
questions.explanation: 교수님이 '사서가 도움을 주는 연구 워크숍이 매주 목요일 오후 2시에 있다'고 설명했습니다.

questions.q: How many free pages can students print per semester?
